sourceCitation: Recorded work:opening facts mark each resident's opening job; its job record names the employer and title. Every opening job in this prototype starts on the opening day, so residents of the same employer have worked together since then.
sourceEstimate: Deterministic seeded assignment of an employer's resident employees to balanced workgroups no larger than a tunable size; group members are assumed to know each other by name from the opening day. No friendship strength, shift overlap, department or later decision is inferred.
scopeGap: Opening coworkers are expanded for residents with a recorded opening job only; earlier jobs, departments, shifts and coworkers who live outside the town are not modeled, and workgroup size is an uncalibrated tunable value.

reports.noContext: No recorded opening job tenure; no coworker was generated.
reports.singleMember: No other resident works for the same employer; no filler coworker was generated.
reports.filled: Joined a generated workgroup at the recorded employer since the later start date; current closeness remains unestablished.
